current_behavior: Only selected paths, notably stage 30 AMD validation, guard before effects; no single capability guard covers direct mutators.
required_future_behavior: One fail-closed guard on every direct/menu mutation before sudo or first effect.
acceptance_boundary: Hermetic zero-effect and invariant metadata tests for supported, unknown, planned and immutable profiles.

current_behavior: Strict normal parsing can block an old unsafe ISO value before migration.
required_future_behavior: Safe inert pre-parser prompts for a new path without opening or privileging the old value.
acceptance_boundary: Legacy/current/no-op, malformed, symlink, hardlink, inode-swap and publication-failure matrix.

current_behavior: Sensitive config with st_nlink greater than one is accepted; rename only separates names after publication.
required_future_behavior: Reject non-single-link regular targets before load/save publication.
acceptance_boundary: Fixture fails closed with original bytes/metadata intact.

current_behavior: Concurrent device, inode and link-count changes immediately before mv are not revalidated and publication succeeds.
required_future_behavior: Use lstat/descriptors and revalidate device, inode, type and link count immediately before rename.
acceptance_boundary: Concurrent replacement returns conflict and preserves both evidence and target.

current_behavior: Rename and mode preservation exist, but owner/group, flush and directory fsync are not fully proved.
required_future_behavior: Apply complete metadata and durability protocol on same filesystem.
acceptance_boundary: Failure matrix proves all-or-nothing content and metadata.

current_behavior: Equivalent CPU/disk records in a different textual order are reported as a hardware change.
required_future_behavior: Normalize by stable identity before semantic comparison.
acceptance_boundary: Reordering passes; actual identity change still fails with field-specific delta.

current_behavior: I0 validates malformed/type/backing-chain fixtures structurally but does not directly invoke backup-vm.sh embedded JSON parser.
required_future_behavior: Core parser consumes captured JSON with typed closed-schema errors and direct consumer tests.
acceptance_boundary: Each qemu-img fixture drives the migrated public wrapper without host qemu-img effects.

current_behavior: Failure or signal leaves cmdline, vfio.conf and/or initramfs effects already applied.
required_future_behavior: One transaction snapshots, restores and semantically verifies all persistent resources.
acceptance_boundary: Failure/signal after every publication leaves verified original state.

current_behavior: Current cmdline and next-boot persisted intent are not modeled as independent facts.
required_future_behavior: Prove active and persistent state separately and no-op only when both converge.
acceptance_boundary: Hermetic matrix plus two real reboots in I13.

current_behavior: --remover-video and --anti-code43 mutate domain XML after the principal transaction commits.
required_future_behavior: Protect all option combinations in the main or a second complete transaction.
acceptance_boundary: Failure/signal at optional XML effects restores hooks, service and XML.

current_behavior: A rollback virsh define returning zero but not applying the original XML is accepted.
required_future_behavior: Reread and compare managed semantics before reporting restoration.
acceptance_boundary: Zero-divergent shim produces grave error and retained recovery evidence.

current_behavior: Second execution preserves hostdev cardinality but creates backups/republications and is not an exact no-op.
required_future_behavior: Converged state performs no unnecessary effect or metadata change.
acceptance_boundary: Second-run effect count is zero for managed state.

current_behavior: Network rollback can report success after a zero-return divergent domain restore.
required_future_behavior: Reread and semantically compare every restored resource before success.
acceptance_boundary: Divergence yields grave error, never a success message.

current_behavior: On unproved rollback, temporary evidence is removed and no recovery_id/instruction is emitted.
required_future_behavior: Retain bounded 0600 recovery bundle/mapping and emit only a random recovery locator and safe command.
acceptance_boundary: Tests prove retention, redaction, expiry metadata and idempotent cleanup.

current_behavior: A concurrent domain change is overwritten; a network metadata change remains unnoticed.
required_future_behavior: Fingerprint before apply and restore; any external change returns conflict.
acceptance_boundary: Concurrent shim leaves external state untouched and no false commit.

current_behavior: NAT refuses a homonymous unmanaged network, but bridge preserves it and continues creating the host bridge.
required_future_behavior: Any homonymous unmanaged network causes safe refusal before related effects.
acceptance_boundary: NAT and bridge both preserve state and return an ownership diagnostic.

current_behavior: Repeated NAT/bridge converges content but republishes config/effects and changes exact observable state.
required_future_behavior: Converged operation is an exact no-op where the contract requires it.
acceptance_boundary: Content, metadata, mtime and modeled runtime remain invariant on second run.

current_behavior: Failure immediately after the synthetic write test can leave .teste-escrita in bind and transit paths.
required_future_behavior: Cleanup transaction-owned test artifacts on every pre-commit exit.
acceptance_boundary: Failure/signal matrix leaves no test artifact.

current_behavior: Rollback action failure is a warning and later rollback continues without one grave aggregate state or proof.
required_future_behavior: Aggregate failures, prove final policy semantically and retain recovery evidence on divergence.
acceptance_boundary: Any unproved post-state is nonzero grave failure with safe instructions.

current_behavior: Apply has effective sshd checks but --verificar relies on superficial presence checks.
required_future_behavior: Apply and verifier share account/SSH/bindfs/fingerprint/firewall positive and negative IPv4/IPv6 evaluation.
acceptance_boundary: Each failed post-condition is distinguished and never returns completed.

current_behavior: Second run avoids duplicate fstab/UFW semantics but still performs effects and changes observable content.
required_future_behavior: Converged policy is no-op except explicitly necessary probes.
acceptance_boundary: Managed files, metadata and runtime are invariant.

current_behavior: No transaction traps are armed before the first domain define; immediate failure or INT/TERM/EXIT leaves discard=unmap.
required_future_behavior: Arm traps first, use explicit states and restore every pre-commit failure/signal.
acceptance_boundary: Every mutating window preserves signal code and original XML.

current_behavior: A zero-return divergent rollback define is announced as restored without semantic reread.
required_future_behavior: Reread and compare the correct disk semantics; grave failure if unproved.
acceptance_boundary: Divergent shim cannot produce restoration success.

current_behavior: XML discard alone is the only automated evidence.
required_future_behavior: Qualify actual block allocation/TRIM behavior on disposable storage.
acceptance_boundary: Recorded real-storage procedure and before/after allocation evidence.

current_behavior: Guest ping conflates installation, VM power and agent availability.
required_future_behavior: Durable namespaced installation metadata bound to QCOW2 identity plus independent states.
acceptance_boundary: Power/agent loss does not erase installation; disk replacement invalidates binding.

current_behavior: workingDisk and HD1 can refer to the same physical device through aliases or mapper/partition relationships.
required_future_behavior: Resolve stable common physical identity and reject equality/ambiguity.
acceptance_boundary: Alias, partition, by-id, mapper, absent-ID and collision fixtures.

current_behavior: VID:PID can select ambiguously and enumeration order may decide.
required_future_behavior: Persist serial or physical port and revalidate before attach.
acceptance_boundary: Unique, duplicate, no-serial, reconnect and stale-selection tests.

current_behavior: Waiver keys are accepted but do not consistently alter status, menu prerequisites, direct execution and summaries.
required_future_behavior: Implement explicit audited policy/transitions or remove safely.
acceptance_boundary: All flag combinations preserve public sentinel semantics and reject contradictory legacy state.

current_behavior: At least util/atualizar-host.sh --validar can print an error and return zero.
required_future_behavior: Error, unavailable tools and unproved state can never report completed.
acceptance_boundary: Contract tests for every --verificar/--validar path.

current_behavior: Platform resolver exists, but stages can still resolve/use backend inconsistently.
required_future_behavior: One provider result for backend, unit and authorized action with semantic post-condition.
acceptance_boundary: Monolithic, modular, missing, failed restart and bad final-state matrix.

current_behavior: No versioned pipeline was identified.
required_future_behavior: CI supplies ShellCheck and runs syntax, suite, whitespace/index/untracked manifest checks without host installation.
acceptance_boundary: Local I0 records missing optional tools instead of installing them.

current_behavior: Clone-local object audit found no exact local config but cannot establish remote/reflog/host-wide absence or substitute a secret scanner.
required_future_behavior: Review authoritative remotes/history with approved tooling and rotate any exposed credentials/identifiers as appropriate.
acceptance_boundary: Do not publish local config values or infer safety from this limited audit.
